problem: Chats and agents returned auto-merge/gate-pending status to the user as if delivery ownership had ended.
root_cause: The continuity contract rejected false LIVE claims but did not explicitly forbid non-terminal delivery states as final user-facing handoffs.
prevention: PENDING_IS_INTERNAL_STATE: queued/running/auto-merge/merge/deploy/readback pending states are never terminal user-facing outcomes.
OWNER_PERSISTS_TO_TERMINAL: the originating or recovering node owns the lineage through production readback and canonical writeback.
RESUME_WITHOUT_USER_NUDGE: interruption resumes from canonical state without requiring the user to say ga door.
ONLY_HARD_BOUNDARY_CAN_STOP_EARLY: before LIVE_BEWEZEN only a proven BLOCKED_HARD_BOUNDARY may end execution.

borging_closure.rule: BORGING_IS_MATERIAL_WRITEBACK: a canonical borging/closure is itself a material outcome and must be logged, documented, projected to relevant skills, regression-guarded, merged and read back from main before it is terminal.

closure_delivery_recovery_evidence.symptom: Required automation failed because a synthetic test headSha contained non-hex characters.
closure_delivery_recovery_evidence.root_cause: Regression fixture drifted behind the stricter exact-head identity contract.
closure_delivery_recovery_evidence.prevention: Synthetic delivery identities used by tests must satisfy the same 12-40 hex SHA contract as runtime candidates.

closure_delivery_recovery_evidence.symptom: Protected browser gate measured /prijzen phone CLS 0.165 above the 0.100 limit.
closure_delivery_recovery_evidence.root_cause: The pricing counter cell became position:fixed globally while its mobile row remained sticky, producing unstable mobile layout.
closure_delivery_recovery_evidence.prevention: Keep the desktop fixed counter, but reset the inner counter cell to position:static inside the <=900px sticky mobile row and regression-test the override.
